[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Belltown Inn: Budget-friendly hotel with views of the city, Puget Sound, and Olympic Mountains.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] User expressed interest in The Edgewater Hotel.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided more information about The Edgewater Hotel:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Location: Pier 67, directly over Puget Sound, within walking distance to Pike Place Market and Seattle Aquarium.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] History: Established in 1962, renovated, famous guests include The Beatles and Pearl Jam.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Rooms and Suites: 223 rooms with various views, including waterfront and city views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Amenities: Edgewater Spa, fitness center, waterfront dining at The Edgewater Grill, lobby bar, 24-hour room service.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Services: Concierge services, valet parking, pet-friendly policy.
